transcript:
Okay, so it's late it's about 11.15 p.m. And I'm exhausted and I
almost didn't record this but I need it because it was a big day
Psychologically and I want to have the data So did a half marathon this
morning. The race started at 8 a.m. I finished it one hour 54 minutes,
which I'm genuinely proud of that That's a PB for me by about four
minutes the first 10k felt good I was running around 5:20 per kilometer
Second half got hard around the 15k mark Legs felt really heavy and I
had a bit of dark patch mentally for maybe two kilometers Where I just
wanted to stop but I pushed through Heart rate was averaging I think
around 168 peaked probably at 182 in the last kilometer. I Took a gel at
7k and another one at 14k bought the SiS orange ones Drank at every
water station finished immediately after finishing it I felt really
nauseous for about 10 minutes Almost vomited which apparently is quite
common Then I was fine ate a banana and a protein bar at the finish line
around 10 15 or so Then we went for brunch big group at a place called
bills I had eggs Benedict and a coffee and a fresh juice Finishing it
finished eating maybe 1230 came home slept for two hours, which is very
unlike me I almost never nap didn't take any supplements today except
the morning NAC and creatine Which I took at 7 a.m. Before the race Legs
are sore now Expected DOMS is going to be real tomorrow. I think The
Novothor today obviously going to take ibuprofen 400 milligram and
magnesium glycinate before bed HRV is going to be interesting tomorrow.
I would expect it to tank Actually one more thing right knee is a tiny
bit tender on the outside Started noticing it maybe kilometer 18 Lateral
side probably ITB related. I have had this before not to it, but logging
it
